name: Blue Caves
summary: Classic September sea-cave outing when wind and water conditions are good.
bestFor: Clear-water photos, swimming stops, and a special half-day.

name: Porto Limnionas
summary: Rocky cove with deep blue water and a more dramatic coastline feel.
bestFor: Swimming, water shoes, lunch nearby, sunset-side exploring.

name: Gerakas Beach
summary: Long sandy beach area often associated with turtle nesting protection.
bestFor: A softer beach day and a quieter morning start.

name: Navagio viewpoint area
summary: Cliff-view candidate for a photo stop; confirm access and safety before going.
bestFor: Views, not swimming. Check current local access rules before relying on it.

name: Bochali
summary: Hillside area with views over town, useful for a relaxed evening.
bestFor: Sunset drinks, town views, and a gentle dinner plan.

name: Zakynthos Town
summary: Good fallback for cafes, harbor walks, small museums, shops, and dinner.
bestFor: Rainy weather, arrival evening, or an easier no-driving plan.
